topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
consensus_response: L-DACS integration significantly increases interference in congested airspace due to its full-duplex nature. This exacerbates spectral crowding caused by aircraft velocity, leading to Doppler effects and increased interference. Traditional spectrum management techniques struggle to address this, impacting A2G and satellite link performance.  Advanced techniques like TDD, AMC, and DSA are crucial for mitigating interference and optimizing spectral efficiency.  The choice of integration strategy must consider the impact on network performance and capacity.
reference_context: L-DACS integration, utilizing full-duplex operation, creates a bottleneck in spectrum sharing due to simultaneous transmissions on the same frequency band. This directly impacts the capacity and performance of both terrestrial and satellite links.  Traditional spectrum management approaches are inadequate, necessitating advanced techniques like TDD, AMC, and DSA for optimal performance in congested airspace.
